row.proto: int32_t Career_Calc_UpgradeCost(void *list, void *inst, void *mods, uint32_t option)
row.notes: Research/development cost of one upgrade instance for an option (option & 6 picks cost_to_develop): base cost x team cost-scale modifiers + per-owned + event percent. Only eax is written; callers compare it signed (cmp eax,ebp ; jg at 0x143532b86).

verify.notes: V0181 Role and the 4 params right: rcx list (passed to 0x1435260b0), rdx inst (base cost +0x5c/+0x60 picked by option&6, state-dependent scaling), r8 mods (8-byte entries at +8..+0x10), r9d option bits; 4 E8 callers. Off: return type. Every return path writes eax only and callers read eax with a signed compare (cmp eax,ebp; jg at 0x143532b86), so expect int32_t, not uint64_t

V0219 sigcheck OK, entry window and jump table 0x14584fe48 clean; 4 args match, base = inst+0x5c or +0x60 by option&6, mods vector kinds 3/0x13 scale, 0x14 percent, 10 x owned count; eax only (vcvttss2si eax / mov eax,[inst+0x90|0xa4]); 4 callers, two compare signed (jg at 0x143532b88, 0x1435338e9), two return it
